planets.name: HD 22946 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 22946 with a 47.4-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 22946 d was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 22946. Its orbit and size follow Garai et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
